# Welcome {-}  
  
These are the lecture notes for **MFE 809: Financial System and the  
Practice of Banking in Nigeria** at Kaduna State University. The  
course provides an in-depth analysis of the Nigerian financial system  
— its structure, institutions, regulatory framework, and operational  
dynamics — and explores banking practices, financial intermediation,  
monetary policy, risk management, financial innovation, and  
contemporary issues in the Nigerian banking sector.  
  
## Course objectives {-}  
  
By the end of this course, students should be able to:  
  
- Analyze the structure and functions of the Nigerian financial system  
- Evaluate the role of financial institutions in economic development  
- Examine banking operations and practices in Nigeria  
- Assess regulatory and supervisory frameworks  
- Understand monetary policy transmission mechanisms  
- Analyze risks in banking and financial institutions  
- Evaluate financial sector reforms and innovations  
  
## Learning outcomes {-}  
  
Students will be able to:  
  
- Demonstrate advanced knowledge of financial intermediation  
- Critically evaluate banking policies and reforms in Nigeria  
- Apply analytical tools to financial sector issues  
- Conduct empirical and policy-based research

## Teaching and assessment {-}  
  
**Teaching methods:** lectures, case studies on the Nigerian banking  
sector, seminar presentations, and data analysis/empirical reviews.  
  
**Assessment:**  
  
- *Continuous assessment (30%)* — assignments, class participation,  
  group presentations  
- *Final examination (70%)*  
  
**Course requirements:** regular attendance, participation in  
seminars, submission of assignments, and a term paper on a Nigerian  
financial system topic.  
  
**Practical components:** analysis of Nigerian bank financial  
statements, review of monetary policy reports, and case studies of  
banking crises in Nigeria.  
  
:::{.rmdnote}  
Advanced additions available for interested students: econometric  
analysis of banking data, financial modelling, and policy simulation  
exercises.  
:::  
  
## Recommended reading {-}  
  
**Core textbooks:** *Financial Institutions and Markets*; *The  
Nigerian Financial System*.  
  
**Journals and reports:** Central Bank of Nigeria Statistical  
Bulletin; NDIC Annual Reports; IMF and World Bank financial sector  
reports. See the References chapter for full details.
